query: UPDATE pages_cache SET last_edited_ms = touched.ms FROM (SELECT b.page_id AS page_id, MAX(json_extract(j.value, '$[1]')) AS ms FROM json_each(?) AS j JOIN blocks b ON b.id = json_extract(j.value, '$[0]') GROUP BY b.page_id) AS touched WHERE pages_cache.page_id = touched.page_id AND touched.ms > pages_cache.last_edited_ms
